1_correctness.details: Role deploys uv-managed Python bot from mnemonic-org fork (PR-pending phase) with pinned commit strategy. Supports seamless upstream transition post-merge. DYNAMIC feature pre-flight gate prevents silent degradation.

2_idempotency.details: Proper idempotency gating: git clone conditional on repo stat, uv sync checks stdout, templates notify handlers only on change, systemd daemon-reload on unit change. Second run should yield 0 changed.

3_fqcn.details: All modules use fully-qualified canonical names: ansible.builtin.*, community.sops.* where present. No bare 'shell' or 'git' references found.

4_variable_scoping.details: Consistent telegram_ai_agent_* prefix throughout (home, config_dir, owner, group, uv_version, etc). Defaults sensible and documented. Runtime vars (tokens, tailscale_ip) required and validated.

5_handler_design.details: Handlers cleanly separated: 'Daemon reload' (systemd-service daemon_reload) vs 'Reload telegram-ai-agent' (systemd-service state=reloaded). Proper listen: naming. Meta flush_handlers gates service start.

6_templates.details: Three templates present (config.yml.j2, .env.j2, systemd unit). No shell injection detected. .env.j2 has no_log protection on render task. Jinja2 syntax sound. Config.yml validates via Python --check-config. Minor: .env.j2 conditional for optional keys uses is defined check (safe).

7_molecule_scenario.details: Converge: sets test secrets (no_log=true), mocks telegram-topics.yml, includes role. Verify: comprehensive 13-assertion suite checks uv, repo, venv, config files, permissions, systemd state, DYNAMIC sentinels (8 topics), env vars, source presence. Docker Ubuntu 24.04 platform good. FINDING: molecule.yml lacks prepare.yml invocation explicitly in verifier section; converge implicitly runs prepare (ok but could be clearer).

8_readme_quality.details: 450+ lines; exceptional coverage: fork/upstream transition logic, PR-pending/post-merge phases, fallback policy (30-day timeout), usage examples (basic + SOPS), all 11 variables documented, cross-role deps (T02, T05, T08) with section references, troubleshooting, security hardening, idempotency guarantee, testing (molecule/lint/smoke).

9_meta_deps.details: meta/main.yml lists all three required dependencies: base (op user), telegram-init (topics inventory), tailscale (resolver IP). Dependency order correct (base first). No missing upstream roles.

10_tag_usage.details: Comprehensive tagging: telegram-ai-agent (main), uv, git, preflight, dirs, deps, config, secrets, systemd, healthcheck. Tags enable selective runs (e.g., --tags telegram-ai-agent,config). 'always' tag on validation block is correct.

11_no_log_secrets.details: no_log: true on .env template render (line 217 tasks/main.yml). Converge test sets secrets with no_log: true. Token variables not echoed in task names. Pre-flight validation block does not expose secrets.

recommendations.title: Molecule prepare.yml clarity
recommendations.description: molecule.yml lists 'prepare: prepare.yml' but prepare.yml is minimal (no-op or missing). Consider adding explicit section if prepare tasks are needed, or clarify in comment that prepare runs implicit systemd/docker setup.

recommendations.title: uv version pinning strategy
recommendations.description: telegram_ai_agent_uv_version defaults to '0.5.3'. Document upgrade path: How often to review for security/feature updates? Consider quarterly cadence or SLA-driven updates.

recommendations.title: Error handling on git fetch
recommendations.description: Line 73: changed_when checks for 'HEAD detached' or 'Switched' in git_fetch.stdout. Consider also checking git_fetch.rc to ensure no failures. Task should fail on rc != 0.

test_coverage.notes: Molecule covers artifact creation (files, directories, systemd). Integration (bot responsiveness, workspace-manager resolver) requires real deployment on fabric VM + operator phone test (send /ping to ops topic).

security_assessment.secrets_handling: STRONG — .env 0600, no_log on templates, tokens not in logs
security_assessment.network_exposure: MINIMAL — resolver URL tailnet-only (100.x.x.x), no public binding

idempotency_verification.reasoning: git conditional on repo_stat.exists, uv sync only if Synced|updated in stdout, template handlers only on content change, systemd daemon-reload only on unit change

summary.text: Role T09 (telegram-ai-agent) is production-ready. Deploys uv-managed Python bot with DYNAMIC feature gate for per-message worktree isolation. Excellent idempotency, security hardening, README documentation, and fork/upstream transition strategy. Molecule tests comprehensive. Minor: git fetch should check rc, molecule prepare.yml clarity.
